project.name: Lathones
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 2 of 8. Strict settlement merit, See, café-led Eat, all named trail providers, picnic, public visitor parking, public toilets, access, transport, dogs and complete local HES/NRHE construction dates were checked before continuing. Inn dining, parking and toilets are customer facilities and do not count as general town provision. Nearby St Andrews and Peat Inn attractions are not transferred.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: Lathones is a roadside village centred on an inn, but the inn is meal-and-accommodation-led rather than the agreed café offer. Customer facilities and nearby attractions do not create a rounded visitor destination.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: No destination-scale dog visit or dedicated dog facilities are assumed without current evidence.
